detect_device: detect the best available computation device by checking CUDA, XPU, HPU, or CPU availability
dispatch_model_by_all_available_devices: dispatch a PyTorch model across all available GPU devices using balanced memory allocation
clear_memory: clear GPU and CPU memory by emptying caches and collecting garbage on specified devices
parse_available_devices: parse a device map string or dict and return a normalized list of available device names
memory_monitor_update: update the global memory monitor singleton to track peak RAM and VRAM usage across devices
